label: Has default aspiration
summary: Whether the house has a default house aspiration.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a dynasty house. Vanilla only ever checks it with `yes`.

label: Active diarchy parameter
summary: Whether the character's diarchy has the named parameter switched on at its current power level.
details: A parameter is a named setting of the diarchy that applies at some power levels. Use it on the ruler (the game's documentation example runs it on the liege). Compare `has_diarchy_parameter`, which only asks whether the parameter can ever be on. Vanilla values include `diarchy_is_co_rulership` and `diarchy_is_vizierate`.

label: Diarchy parameter
summary: Whether the character's diarchy can have the named parameter at some power level.
details: It does not say the parameter is on right now. For that, use `has_diarchy_active_parameter`. Works on a character, usually the ruler. Vanilla values include `diarchy_is_vizierate` and `diarchy_type_is_junior_emperorship`.

label: Diarchy type
summary: Whether the character is in a diarchy of the given type.
details: The game's documentation says it works even when no diarchy is active. Vanilla uses types such as `grand_secretariat`, `co_emperorship`, `regency`, `temporary_regency` and `vizierate`. Works on a character.

label: Has disabled building
summary: Whether the holding connected to the title has at least one disabled building.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a landed title.

label: Has divorce reason
summary: Whether the character has a divorce reason against the given character.
details: The target is the other person. Vanilla uses it once, with `root` as the target.

label: Has DLC
summary: Whether the game host has the named DLC.
details: Write the DLC's full name, for example `Friends and Foes`. The game's documentation lists 11 names, but vanilla also uses `All Under Heaven`, so the list in the game's documentation is not complete. Not tied to a scope.

label: Has DLC feature
summary: Whether the game host owns a DLC that turns on the named feature.
details: Write a feature key such as `royal_court`, `tours_and_tournaments` or `legends`. Vanilla uses it very often (870 times). The game's documentation lists the valid feature keys.

label: Has doctrine
summary: Whether the faith has the given doctrine.
details: Write a doctrine key such as `doctrine_monotheist` or `doctrine_no_head`. Works on a faith. To test a whole group of doctrines at once, use `has_doctrine_group`.

label: Has doctrine from group
summary: Whether the faith has any doctrine that belongs to the given doctrine group.
details: Write a doctrine group key. Works on a faith. The input shows no vanilla use, so the value shape comes from the game's documentation only.

label: Has doctrine parameter
summary: Whether the faith has the named parameter, from either its core tenets or its doctrines.
details: A parameter is a named switch that a doctrine or tenet turns on. Vanilla values include `unreformed`, `human_sacrifice_active` and `has_clerical_regions`. Works on a faith.

label: Has domicile
summary: Whether the character has a domicile.
details: A domicile is a home the character can have; vanilla's building names suggest forms such as camps and estates. Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character.

label: Has domicile building
summary: Whether the domicile has a building of the given type.
details: Write a domicile building key such as `estate_main_03`. It matches that exact building, not a better one: for that, use `has_domicile_building_or_higher`. Works on a domicile.

label: Has building or better
summary: Whether the domicile has the given building or one of its upgrades.
details: Write a domicile building key such as `estate_main_02`. A later upgrade of that building also counts. Works on a domicile.

label: Building under construction
summary: Whether the domicile is building the given building right now.
details: Write a domicile building key. Works on a domicile.

label: Domicile parameter
summary: Whether at least one building of the domicile has the named parameter.
details: A parameter is a named switch that a building turns on, for example `cheaper_grain_fields_buildings_1`. Works on a domicile.

label: High domicile temperament
summary: Whether the character's domicile temperament is high.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character. The documented example writes `has_temperament_high`, which looks like a typo for this key.

label: Low domicile temperament
summary: Whether the character's domicile temperament is low.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character. The documented example writes `has_temperament_low`, which looks like a typo for this key.

label: Neutral domicile temperament
summary: Whether the character's domicile temperament is neutral.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character. Vanilla does not use it, and the documented example writes `has_temperament_neutral`, which looks like a typo for this key.

label: Is dominant ruling gender
summary: Whether the given character's gender is one the faith favours for rulers.
details: Also true when the faith has no dominant ruling gender. Works on a faith; the target is the character to check. Vanilla mostly passes `prev`.

label: Dread level towards
summary: Whether the character is scared of the target to the given degree.
details: Dread levels are 0 (not intimidated), 1 (intimidated) and 2 (cowed). The level can be compared with `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=` or `=`.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character the scope character may be afraid of.

fields.name: level
fields.text: The dread level to test, with an optional comparison.

label: Artifact decays
summary: Whether the artifact loses durability over time.
details: Ownership matters: artifacts owned by a holy site do not decay. Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on an artifact.

label: Has dynasty
summary: Whether the character belongs to a valid dynasty.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character.

label: Has dynasty modifier
summary: Whether the dynasty has the named modifier.
details: Write a modifier key, for example `strong_blood`. Works on a dynasty.

label: Dynasty modifier time left
summary: Whether the dynasty has time remaining on the named modifier.
details: Works on a dynasty. The game's documentation gives only the form `= name`, and vanilla does not use it, so how a duration is compared is not shown.

label: Has legacy perk
summary: Whether the dynasty has unlocked the given dynasty perk.
details: Write a perk key such as `law_legacy_1`. Vanilla's keys (`law_legacy_1`, `guile_legacy_5`) look like numbered steps of a legacy. Works on a dynasty.

label: Votes for in election
summary: Whether the given character is voting for the scoped character in the election of the given title.
details: It runs on the character who would receive the vote; `who` is the voter.

fields.name: title
fields.text: The title whose election is meant.

label: Has court position
summary: Whether the character holds any employed court position.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character.

label: Has ethnicity
summary: Whether the character has the given ethnicity.
details: The game's documentation shows no value form and vanilla does not use it, so what exactly is written there is not shown.

label: Has execute reason
summary: Whether the character has a reason to execute the target.
details: The target is the person who would be executed. Vanilla passes scopes such as `scope:victim` and `scope:recipient`. Works on a character.

label: Has faith
summary: Whether the character follows the given faith.
details: Write a faith, such as `faith:catholic`, or a link to one, such as `root.faith`. Works on a character.

label: Has living father
summary: Whether the character has a valid, living father.
details: Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character.

label: Has first name
summary: Whether the character has the given first name, or the same first name as another character.
details: Names that are cultural equivalents count as equal. A regnal name is used when one is set. The game's documentation warns that it is slow, so use it with care. Write a localization key, or a block with `character = ...`.

fields.name: character
fields.text: Another character whose first name is compared (block form).

label: Has exact first name
summary: Whether the character has exactly the given first name, or exactly the same first name as another character.
details: Unlike `has_first_name`, cultural equivalents do not count. A regnal name is used when one is set. The game's documentation warns that it is slow. Its examples name the key `has_first_name_base_strict`, which looks like a typo.

fields.name: character
fields.text: Another character whose first name is compared (block form).

label: Has focus
summary: Whether the character has the given focus.
details: Write a focus key such as `education_martial` or `stewardship_domain_focus`. Works on a character.

label: Is forced defender
summary: Whether the given character is forced to defend in this Great Holy War.
details: Works on a Great Holy War. The target is a character, for example `root` or `scope:target_kingdom.holder`.

label: Has free building slot
summary: Whether the province has a free building slot.
details: Written as `yes`. Works on a province.

label: Has free council slot
summary: Whether the character has a council position that still needs filling.
details: Positions the game fills automatically are ignored. Written as `yes` or `no`. Works on a character.

label: Fulfillment parameter
summary: Whether the character's current spiritual fulfillment level has the named parameter.
details: A parameter is a named switch the level turns on. Vanilla values include `sp_cheaper_pilgrimage` and `pious_puppet_option`. Works on a character.

label: Game rule on
summary: Whether the given game rule setting is enabled.
details: Write the setting's key, such as `hard_difficulty` or `faster_conversion`. Not tied to a scope.
